༄༅/ /rnam thar gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam thar gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ don gnyis mthar phyin yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden gnyis dbyer med 'gog lam dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'brel nyams len dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhung lugs mang du thos pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /blo bzang grags pa'i mdo sngags lung rtogs bstan/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la=/ /de nyid sngon bsags legs par spyad pa'i mthus/ /dal 'byor rten rnyed chung ngu'i dus na yang*/ /rtsol cher med par yig klog 'bri 'don sogs/ /kun la byang bar gyur la=/ /bstan la rab byung chog bsgrigs mang bzung zhing*/ /blo gros gsal ldan dkar ram bya snyam tshe/ /mtshan nyid mkhas pa'i bla chen 'gas bskul ltar/ / dbus su 'gro 'dod shar la=/ /de tshe pha mas gnang ste grogs bzang la/ / brten nas dbus phyin chos grwar zhugs pa na/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad rtsol shugs drag gis/ /gzhung mang 'dzin par mdzad la=/ /se ra'i tshogs chen dge 'dun sde dbus su/ /lan 'ga' dbu mar 'dul mdzod tshogs lang dus/ / gzhan dang brgal brtags lung dang rigs pa yis/ /pha rol dpa' skong mdzad la=/ /grwa sar bcu phrag lo steng bla ma nyid/ /mnyes nas lha sar ming gdags mdzad gsung ltar/ /bsgrubs tshe mkhas kun rigs lung char phab kyang*/ / thogs med lan 'debs mdzad la=/ /yig sdeb snyan ngag sgra rtsis gzhung mang la/ /sbyangs nas rgyud dang dga' ldan 'bras spungs su/ /mdo sngags gzhung la dam bca' legs bzhag pas/ /mkhas rnams mgu bar mdzad la=/ /bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs pad nyer bsten nas/ /dbang lung man ngag bdud rtsi 'thung byas shing*/ /rgyud grwar zhugs nas sngags kyi phyogs dag la/ /thos bsam nyams len mdzad =/ las sred smon lam dbang gis rang yul du/ /'ongs nas gzhung mang dag la thos bsam dang*/ /bka' 'gyur chen mo tshar gcig bsgrags gyur pas/

/blo gros gong 'phel gyur la=/ /smon lam legs spyad dag pas mtshams sbyar te/ /phyogs 'dir gsar btsugs 'chad nyan bla ma ru/ /dpon gyis bskos pas thog mar grwa tshang la/ /lan mang phan gdags mdzad la=/ /de tshe log sgrub rlung gis mi g.yo bar/ /ko'u shri'i zhabs dang lhan cig 'chad nyan dang*/ /grwa khang gsar rgyags skor la gros mthun gyis/ /phan mang nges par sgrub la=/ /'on kyang gang dag gzu bor mi gnas shing*/ /drin bzos dben pa'i blo ngor ji ltar yang*/ /phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i rgyun la phan btags par/ /kun gyis dga' bar mdzad la=/ /rang dgon 'di yi mkhan po'i go sa ru/ /lan gnyis bskos shing rgyud pa gsar btsugs la'ang*/ /slob dpon gyur tshe gsang bde 'jigs sogs kyi/ /'chad nyan dar bar mdzad la=/ /dad ldan mang la dbang bskur rgyud bshad cing*/ /rgyal bstan yun ring gnas pa'i cha rkyen du/ / dgongs 'grel bstan bcos mdo sngags po ti'i skor/ /bcu phrag lhag tsam mdzad la=/ /dus kyi dbang dang kun rtog rags stobs kyis/ /sa lam rtogs pa mthon po ma rnyed kyang*/ /nyin mtshan dag tu kha ton dge sbyor la/ /brtson pas 'jug par mdzad la=/ /'on te lta ba'i tshul la rtag 'bad cing*/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam snying rje'i ri rab khur/ /byang chub bar du 'dor med 'khyer byed pa'i/ /dam bca' rgyun du mdzad la=/ /rigs gsum mgon sogs lhag pa'i lha mang dang*/ /gsang bde 'jigs kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad kyang*/ /rtogs pa'i dngos grub ring yang de kun gyi/ /byin rlabs zhugs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs gnas bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung mthu byin dang*/ /rten 'brel mi slu dad cing mos stobs kyis/ / yongs 'dzin tshogs rnams bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /skye ba kun du zhes sogs brjod kyang mi 'gal lo/ /ces pa 'di ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gur yags ri khrod pa dge slong 'jam dbyangs brtson 'grus kyis rnam thar gsol 'debs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan tan du bskul ba'i ngor/

shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis ngo ma zlog par g.yar khral du bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ rnam thar gsol 'debs bzhugs/ - PAGE 310-- PAGE 311-- PAGE 309-
